label: 外墙挂板
description: 追加 facade_panel(...)：外立面挂板 / siding 薄板，可带水平 reveal 板缝阵列。默认竖直挂板（orientation=wall，板高沿 Z、底面 Z=0，与墙一致）；orientation=slab 时平躺（板高沿 Y）。当 prompt 提到 外墙板 / 挂板 / 壁板 / siding / cladding 时使用。
description-en: Append `facade_panel(...)` — exterior cladding/siding sheet with optional horizontal reveal grooves. Defaults to a vertical wall panel (orientation=wall, height along Z, base at Z=0, like a wall); orientation=slab lays it flat (height along Y). Use for siding, cladding, facade panel.

inputs.name: panel_h
inputs.label: 板高
inputs.description: 板高（米）：orientation=wall 时沿 Z（竖直），slab 时沿 Y（平躺）
inputs.description-en: Panel height (meters): along Z when orientation=wall (vertical), along Y when slab (flat).

inputs.name: thickness
inputs.label: 板厚
inputs.description: 板厚（米）：wall 时沿 Y，slab 时沿 Z
inputs.description-en: Thickness (meters): along Y when wall, along Z when slab.

inputs.name: orientation
inputs.label: 朝向
inputs.description: wall 竖直挂板（默认，板高沿 Z、底面 Z=0）/ slab 平躺（板高沿 Y）
inputs.description-en: wall = vertical panel (default, height along Z, base at Z=0) / slab = laid flat (height along Y).

inputs.name: groove_spacing
inputs.label: 板缝间距
inputs.description: 按间距布缝（米，优先于板缝数）；0=用板缝数
inputs.description-en: Space grooves by this pitch (overrides count); 0 = use count.

inputs.name: groove_direction
inputs.label: 板缝方向
inputs.description: horizontal 横 / vertical 竖 / both 双向

inputs.name: board_style
inputs.label: 板样式
inputs.description: flush 平缝 / lap 深缝搭接 / shiplap 企口宽缝

inputs.name: id
inputs.label: id
inputs.description: 自定义 id；空 = 自动 facade{n}

outputs.name: geometry
outputs.label: 几何
outputs.description: 追加 facade_panel 行后的 Geometry
outputs.description-en: Geometry after appending the facade panel.
